coverageGaps.reason: The target-free simplification corpus is small and single-domain; equality saturation and an independent assumption-aware output validator remain unmeasured. Separate native SymPy simplify/factor/cancel/together/apart/trigsimp configurations and a deterministic seeded randomized-valid rewrite control are retained.

B.scope: The same twenty opaque tasks under historical validation, the initial exact validator, and exact validation with nonzero constant denominators.

C.coverage: Four independent campaigns per form with enumerative and seeded random controls. Shared cases across arms and forms are repeated observations. The finite retrospective project inventory tests no external novelty.
C.formation: Only public TRAIN prefixes or start expressions and authorized assumptions. Each form uses its frozen grammar, resource accounts, independent evaluation and project-inventory audit.

D.coverage: Retrospective public factoring stress test, two disjoint TRAIN coefficient series and two held-out expression families. Public evaluation cases and their deliberate construction preclude protected-test or independent-discovery claims. A newly compiled copy of an available factorization rule is not project novelty. No parameter tuning or family substitution after registration.
D.informationParity: Run default native AST rules and untargeted BestFirstSearch on each expression, then OpenTargetConjectureMiner independently on each opaque batch. Input contains root expressions only. Supply no targets, family names, held-out examples or validation outcomes to search or mining. Attach the registered family label only after each candidate set is fixed. Identify independently formed candidates by miner ID plus the digest of their observation IDs; never count identical observation IDs twice. Preserve all rejected clusters, including duplicate or neutral variants. Apply CrossFamilyStructuralClusterer and CrossFamilyBridgeHypothesisBuilder. Retain all eligible bridges in canonical order. Zero eligible bridges is a reportable null.

F.scope: Finish only genuinely eligible actions. Retain rejected/inconclusive or zero-output batches and missing preassigned slots. Track gate status, actual receipt identity, candidate lineage, native resources and exact reasons. No increase to positive or scientific claims or formal proof authority. Compute between-arm comparisons only on matching public panel, never pool with #1204.
F.sharedBudget: One dispatch ticket is one opportunity to launch a stage operation on a generated catalog, a registered aggregate batch, or a candidate lineage. Uniformity is measured in these predeclared discrete opportunities, never summed resource counts or equal wall time. Every arm has fourteen tickets and the same immutable native resource ceilings from #355. Record configured/executed/skipped/remaining for tickets and every native resource. No transfer between resource units.
